description:
Why Is Poop Brown? The Digestion Journey! — You eat green broccoli, orange carrots, and yellow bananas. So why does bathroom poop ALWAYS turn brown? Let's solve the case!
Kids science answer for "why is poop brown kids science cartoon" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Even if you eat green kale and red strawberries, liver bile and recycled red blood cells break down into stercobilin, which turns digestion waste brown.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
